editorial.blurb: Carnivale is a full-on celebration where vibrant South American cuisine and spectacular theatre combine into one of Chicago's most electrifying dining experiences.
editorial.insiderTip: Order multiple Caipirinhas and go for the chef's tasting menu or the charrascos/Argentinian Parrillada if you want standout grilled proteins—and embrace the high-energy vibe; this isn't a quiet meal, it's a party.
